packageRules.description: obsidian-headless is pinned in Dockerfile (ARG OB_HEADLESS_VERSION=x.y.z) via a custom regex, not an npm manifest. Track it with the npm datasource so every upstream release opens a PR bumping the pin. CalVer releases: merging a bump triggers CI, which rebuilds ghcr.io/shakataganai/obsidian-headless-backup (main + :latest), and the matching CalVer tag must be published manually (the v tag also rebuilds with deterministic content and re-tags). Manual merge - this backs up Jon's notes.
